subject: Bridge credits for StitchFest maintainers — sprint backfill request
messages:
From: Jamie Park <jamie@stitchfest.org>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: OpenStitch Maintainers <maintainers@openstitch.org>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Bridge credits request for StitchFest maintainers (Dec sprint)

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for last quarter's support. StitchFest is running a linked-maintainer sprint Dec 10–14 where dozens of small OSS projects will run CI, demos, and live pairing sessions that depend on short-lived inference capacity.

We have a couple of asks:
- A small promotional credit top-up (roughly 150k token-equivalent) to cover burst demos + CI for maintainers who don't have compute.
- Ability to extend trial windows for a handful (8–12) of maintainers through Jan 10 so they can reproduce workshop examples after the event.

The attached deck has the program outline and the list of repo leads. Budget is tight so we really appreciate any flexibility. If there are constraints (per-account caps, region limitations), happy to adapt.

Would love to confirm by EOD Monday if possible.

Best,
Jamie Park
Programs Lead — StitchFest
Attachment: stitchfest-runbook-deck.pdf
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Park <jamie@stitchfest.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 12:31:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Bridge credits request for StitchFest maintainers (Dec sprint)

Hi Jamie —

Really appreciate the context and the deck — great program. Short answers up front: we can probably do a combined trial extension + one-time credits for maintainers, but I need to confirm an exact amount and billing notes with my partner ops team. A couple clarifying q's:

1) Expected peak concurrent token/sessions during Dec 10–14 (ballpark)?
2) Which accounts should receive the trial extension (list of emails)?
3) Do you want the credits issued as a single grant code or per-email allocations?

Marissa — looping you in since this looks like a partner promo (recommend review for SLA/limits). If ok from your side I can commit to a 120–175k token top-up + 30-day trial extension for up to 12 maintainers and then provision the grant code.

Thanks —
Sofia Ivanova
Sr. Partnerships (Community & Programs)
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Bridge credits request for StitchFest maintainers (Dec sprint)

Sofia / Rishi —

I reviewed the deck. My read: high visibility opportunity, low unit cost. Cost estimate below:
- 150k token-equivalent usage = ~USD 180 (hosted pricing analog) for promo window.
- If they ask for per-account persistence beyond Jan 10, we need a small MSA clause — but for now short-term extension is fine.

Recommend approving: 150k total, issued as a single redeemable grant code scoped to accounts we list, with region lock EU (they're running EU infra). I'll attach the quick cost calc.

If Rishi ok I can (a) create grant code, (b) update HubSpot deal DF-7821, (c) send onboarding note with maintainer-onboarding-guide.md.

Attachment: cost-estimate-stitchfest.xlsx

—Marissa
Head of Partner Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Bridge credits request for StitchFest maintainers (Dec sprint)

Thanks — approve the 150k grant. Quick operational notes:
- Please scope the code to the list of maintainer emails Jamie will provide. Limit to EU region and single-redeem per account. Expires 2027-01-10T23:59:00Z.
- Add a HubSpot note on DF-7821 and tag deal stage "promo_provisioned".
- Billing: mark as community promo (internal charge code: CF-COMM-2026).

Marissa, can you generate the grant and push the onboarding doc? Sofia, once you have the emails I will sign the outbound confirmation.

Rishi
Director, Business Ops (Revenue)
Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Park <jamie@stitchfest.org>, OpenStitch Maintainers <maintainers@openstitch.org>

Subject: Re: Bridge credits request for StitchFest maintainers (Dec sprint)

Hi Jamie —

All set. We issued a single grant code scoped to the maintainer emails you provided and set the region to EU. Details below and attachments included.

Grant code: STITCH-REDWOOD-2026-12
Amount: 150k token-equivalent
Expires: 2027-01-10T23:59:00Z
Scope: single redeem per account, max 12 accounts, EU-only
Onboarding: see attached maintainer-onboarding-guide.md (quick start, caching tips, and how to avoid hitting rate shaper).

Links/next steps:
- HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/companies/12345/deal/DF-7821 (I added a note and moved to promo_provisioned)
- Please confirm the 8–12 emails that should receive the code (reply-all), we can also drop a short how-to in the maintainer Slack channel.

If you have a couple quote-lines or a one-paragraph case highlight after the sprint, we'd love to feature StitchFest in our community newsletter.

Best of luck with the sprint — ping me if any account needs a top-up.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Sr. Partnerships (Community & Programs)
Redwood Inference
